intro.text: An island chain in the Emerald Sea and the seat of the king, whose palace stands on one of its islands.

description.text: It lies a fair distance from Shimmerbay and much farther from Diggen's Point. How many islands it has is unknown, but some are said to be around forty miles across.
The duke of Diggen's Point travels there from time to time to report to the king on his island.
